text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] hosted-api-us-east: sustained request queue growth detected on /v1/generate. p95 -> 1.3s, p99 -> 12.8s, error-rate 504 increasing. Autoscaler attempted node creation but saw repeated failures (quota/429 from cloud-provisioner).

sara.nguyen: oncall-marc are you available? paging now. :rotating_light:

oncall-marc: i'm awake, grabbing logs. what's current backlog?

mike.ops: backlog ~18k requests across front-tier queues. GPU pool 'hosted-us-east-gpu' at 98% reserved, soft-fail eviction not triggered yet. Autoscaler log shows: `create_nodes -> 429 QuotaExceeded` then retry loop.

alex.kapoor: thanks. immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable routing fallback to cpu-scaling group for non-ml-critical tenants, 2) throttle expensive models to smaller quantized variant, 3) open cloud quota escalation. can someone run the routing change?

sara.nguyen: doing (step 1). I'm flipping the routing rule to prefer 'cpu-fallback' for tier:free and tier:dev. Command: ```bash
# internal routing API
curl -X POST https://console.internal/redwood/routing/deactivate -d '{"route":"hosted-gpu-primary","match":"tier in (free,dev)"}'
```

cloud-qa: note: cpu-fallback has lower throughput; expect p50 to drop but p99 for critical tenants should improve if they get routed to smaller models.

oncall-marc: running step 2 now (model downgrade). Will toggle model alias for 'gpt-large-v1' -> 'gpt-large-q4' for non-SLA tenants.```
# runbook snippet
PATCH /api/v1/models/alias
{ "alias": "gpt-large-v1:non-sla", "to": "gpt-large-q4" }
```

mike.ops: i've started a manual provision attempt while quota ticket is open. Using internal provisioner:```
provisioner allocate --pool hosted-us-east-gpu --count 2 --reason "emergency manual allocation" --force
```
but provisioner returned: `error: quota limit reached (projects/rdw-prod/gpu-cores).`

alex.kapoor: open cloud ticket ASAP, escalate to account manager. Put in estimated impact: ~15% customer timeouts, multiple paid customers seeing request failures.

sara.nguyen: ticket created: CLOUD-987654 (urgency=high). Adding account manager + infra-sre.

incident-bot: @channel incident severity -> Sev2. Paging oncall rotations: infra-sre, cloud-ops.

mike.ops: alternate plan: enable short-lived tokenized pre-warmed CPU workers to handle small generation tasks and defer large ones. I'll spin up an extra 8 prewarm CPU workers via the edge pool:```
edgectl scale --pool hosted-edge --workers 8 --image prewarm-generator:stable
```

oncall-marc: rolling this now. monitor queue delta.

(5m later)
cloud-qa: after routing + prewarm workers, backlog down from 18k -> 7.2k. p95 improved to 650ms, p99 -> 3.9s. Some tail still 504 from GPU-backed long-running jobs.

alex.kapoor: good progress. still need quota resolved. customers impacted list: cust-acme (API 504s), cust-lumen (increased latencies). Notify CS and Status page.

sara.nguyen: status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1797770001 - included mitigation steps and ETA: 2h (subject to cloud response).

mike.ops: cloud response: preliminary quota update - we can bump by +4 GPUs after account review (~45m). Requesting temporary uplift.

oncall-marc: if uplift granted, we'll add nodes and drain CPU-fallback traffic back to GPU model gradually with canary 5%. Command to add nodes post-uplift:```
provisioner allocate --pool hosted-us-east-gpu --count 4 --type a100-80 --tag emergency-uplift
```

incident-bot: note: automatic autoscaler will resume once new nodes report healthy. Current autoscaler suppressed due to quota 429 window.

(40m later)
cloud-qa: cloud approved temporary uplift +4 GPUs. mike.ops executing allocate.

mike.ops: allocate succeeded, nodes registered. starting canary routing 5% -> gpu-primary, monitoring error-rate.

oncall-marc: canary stable for 10m, rolling to 25% then 50%.

(20m later)
cloud-qa: backlog now 1.1k, p95 210ms, p99 820ms, errors falling to baseline. Reverting model alias for non-sla tenants.

sara.nguyen: closing page in 15m unless regression. Preparing postmortem checklist: root cause = quota hit due to sudden multi-tenant campaign + autoscaler retry/backoff not surfacing soft-fail quickly. Action items: 1) add early quota-check circuit in autoscaler (ALERT before repeated 429 retries), 2) improve default fallback routing to cpu for low-tier traffic, 3) runbook update for manual provision and prewarm steps, 4) CS communication follow-up.

alex.kapoor: add metric to console: 'autoscaler_quota_429_rate' and set alert at > 5% over 5m.

incident-bot: incident severity -> resolved (monitoring). Tags: hosted-api, autoscaler, gpu-quota, routing-fallback.

sara.nguyen: thanks everyone. I'll draft the postmortem and circle back with timelines for the actions. :thumbsup:
